'''Elan Dapor''' was a nation of the [[Third Age#The Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]] and rose from the ruins of [[Safer]] and parts of [[Aelgar]]. It was later conquered by the [[false Dragon]] [[Guaire Amalasan]] in {{fy|940}} and was then annexed by the [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire|Empire]] of [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]]. Its territory currently resides within the borders of the modern nation of [[Tarabon]] and part of the southernmost reaches of the [[Almoth Plain]].

==Geography==
[[Image:Elan Dapor.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Elan Dapor was a kingdom of middling size in the Free Years era. It was bordered by the [[Aryth Ocean]] to the west and the [[Mountains of Mist]] to the east. Its northern border ran from the head of the bay south of [[Toman Head]] southeast towards the Mountains of Mist. Its southern border was the [[River Andahar]] and one of its tributaries. Elan Dapor's neighbors were [[Darmovan]] to the north, [[Dhowlan]] to the east, [[Shiota]] to the southeast, and [[Balasun]] to the south.

The name and location of Elan Dapor's capital city are not recorded. No major cities of the modern era lie within its territory (although the city of [[Tanchico]] lay on the border to the south, it appears to have been held by Balasun), and the only known modern settlement within its territory is the Taraboner town of [[Alcruna]]. It is unknown if the town existed at the time of Elan Dapor.

==History==
Very little is known of Elan Dapor's history, save that between {{fy|939}} and FY 940 it was invaded by the armies of Darmovan under the leadership of Guaire Amalasan and was conquered within a few months. After Amalasan's death, Elan Dapor was left leaderless and in chaos. Some years later it was seized during the [[Consolidation|Wars of the Consolidation]] by Artur Hawkwing and made part of the coastal province administered from Tanchico. During the [[War of the Hundred Years]] much of the territory of Elan Dapor was conquered and subjugated by Tarabon.
